senses.gloss: הִתְלִים (denom. of תֶּלֶם) to furrow, leave a ridge.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31:13">Gen. R. s. 31</cite> <he>והיה מַתְלִים תלמיות וכ׳</he> and it (the R’em) left furrows in the water as far as from Tiberias to Susitha; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 926">Yalk. Job 926</cite> <he>מסתלסל</he> (corr. acc.).
